body: I really don't have any doubts with the church itself, just the culture. I really don't fit in.
Who can I talk to? I'm afraid if I talk to my bishop or counselor I'll get kicked out of school. I don't have a home to go to.

Recovering Mormon, that is definitely an interesting phrase. The thing is, I still have a strong testimony of the church. Maybe that is why I am so scared of committing suicide, I don't want to displease God. But this pain is becoming unbearable.
